title: L2GSSL: Label-Efficient Local-to-Global Self-Supervised Learning for Volumetric Healthcare Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.21356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Healthcare institutions routinely accumulate high-dimensional computed tomography (CT) volumes, but only a fraction can be annotated by experts. We present L2GSSL, a local-to-global self-supervised learning framework that leverages unlabeled volumes by decomposing pretraining into intra-slice and inter-slice representation spaces. A slice encoder learns view-invariant local features, and a global encoder aggregates the resulting tokens to model volumetric context. The stop-gradient isolates the local space from the global objective, while slice-wise execution and a three-phase schedule support training under constrained GPU memory. On LIDC-IDRI lung nodule malignancy classification, L2GSSL reaches $0.9229$ AUROC with only $10\%$ of the labels and $0.9377$ with $25\%$, exceeding the volume-level VICReg by $0.0229$ and $0.0294$, respectively. translated_title: L2GSSL：面向体积医疗数据的标签高效局部到全局自监督学习
translated_abstract: 医疗机构通常会积累大量高维计算机断层扫描（CT）体积数据，但其中只有一小部分能够由专家进行标注。我们提出了L2GSSL，这是一个局部到全局的自监督学习框架，通过将预训练分解为切片内和切片间两个表示空间来利用未标注的体积数据。切片编码器学习视图不变的局部特征，全局编码器聚合所得的标记以建模体积上下文。停止梯度机制将局部空间与全局目标隔离开来，而逐切片执行和三阶段训练调度则支持在受限GPU内存条件下的训练。在LIDC-IDRI肺结节恶性分类任务上，L2GSSL仅使用10%的标签即达到0.9229的AUROC，使用25%的标签达到0.9377，分别超过体积级VICReg方法0.0229和0.0294。在使用全部标签的情况下，最强的监督基线也仅比L2GSSL高出0.0044的AUROC，结果表现一致。
tldr: 提出L2GSSL局部到全局自监督学习框架，通过将预训练分解为切片内和切片间表示空间并利用停止梯度隔离目标，在仅使用10%标注的肺结节恶性分类任务上达到0.9229 AUROC，大幅超越体积级对比方法，接近全监督基线性能。
en_tdlr: L2GSSL is a label-efficient local-to-global self-supervised learning framework that decomposes pretraining into intra-slice and inter-slice representation spaces with stop-gradient isolation, achieving 0.9229 AUROC on lung nodule malignancy classification with only 10% of labels, outperforming volume-level VICReg while nearly matching fully supervised baselines.
